products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise for decision-making and performance improvement across the healthcare sector. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates under the Merative name, offering a portfolio of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular workflow, health data analytics, and real-world evidence.

Its product lineup includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support tool aimed at giving clinicians point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials; the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools covering vendor-neutral archiving, universal viewing, and workflow orchestration; Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo for cardiovascular service lines, which the company notes received a 2025 Best in KLAS ranking; and Truven, which provides health data analytics and consulting services. The company also offers a real-world evidence portfolio combining data, services, and applications.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting its focus on healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
